analysis_set.span: The primary analysis was conducted using a modified intention‐to‐treat approach.

follow_up.span: The primary efficacy outcome was the incidence of any documented episode of POAF (defined as AF lasting ≥30 s) within the first 14 days after surgery.

entry_age.span: Adult patients (aged 18–80 years) scheduled for elective on‐pump CABG were eligible.

notes: Sections 2.5 and 3.2 link the primary POAF estimate to modified intention-to-treat analysis; per-protocol analysis was sensitivity only. Section 2.4 establishes a 14-day postoperative endpoint window, including monitoring beyond hospitalization, rather than an exclusively in-hospital window. Follow-up contacts up to 3 months do not redefine the primary endpoint window. Section 2.1 restricts eligibility to elective on-pump CABG, a subset within the question's adult cardiac-surgery population.
